name: Lotus Lake Camp
description_short: Family-run day camp since 1952 on a 16-acre lake in Williamstown, Vermont, for ages 5 to 14 (entering grades K to 9), 9:00 to 4:00 Monday to Friday. Campers are grouped by grade and do Red Cross swim lessons, boats or archery, crafts or tennis, and woodshop or outdoor adventure, plus a daily lunch hike into the woods. Buses from Montpelier, Barre, Williamstown and Northfield.
swim_waterfront_notes: Red Cross swim lessons. Campers must pass LLC's own deep water test, without goggles, to swim in the deep end outside of lessons. Boating is offered as an activity choice.
